This unnamed cave is located in the south of [[Coldridge Valley]] in [[Dun Morogh]], and is inhabited by [[ice troll]]s of the [[Frostmane clan|Frostmane]]. [[Grelin Whitebeard]] has been tasked by the [[Senate of Ironforge]] with investigating the threat posed by the trolls in Coldridge Valley.
